thesis: IPAR is extended at a 52-week high into a broad risk-off tape, and a Goldman downgrade to neutral landed this morning, after the 11/20 close, so it is not yet priced. The 65% rally already discounts the FY2027 guidance (about +6% sales, EPS about $5). The mean analyst target of 131 sits below the price. RSI is near 70 and the stock is 7.9% above SMA20, which makes a fade or gap-down at the open likely. Reward/risk of about 1.9 is modest, and with short interest at 10.7% of float and VIX at the 99th percentile, a failed breakout can move fast.
